content: Naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-e-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogded:

“Dule-gwensak e-ukagi ukamar-mullu-mullu-bukwale, duuled-siidibe, e-ukagi ibmar-sipuu naidibe, yaa-siid naibe-bunayob-dakledibe, we-dule, dule-irwa-anse-goledse seledoed, Aarónʼsedibe, e-masmalasedibe.

Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-ukagi-yaa-siid dakoed. Yaa-siidgi e-siga sipuu naile, degi, yaa ise-nue-gulluu daklegele, wedi, naibe-buna-yaa gued. Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled uka-daksad-sorbali, sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’
”Ar dule-ukagi ibmar-sipu-naid, unnila asginbi-nai daklegele, deginbali, e-siga sipuu daklesurbalile, dule-irwa-anse-goled, ibagugle (7) we-dule dule-baigangi bachikii mesoed.

Geb ibagugledgine (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled, we-dule-e-uka gannar dakbaloed. Ar amba gannar deyob yaa daklegele, degi, ega bar nasgusulile, dule-irwa-anse-goled, gannar ibagugle (7) we-dule mesbaloed.

Geb ibagugle-nasad-sorbali (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled, we-dule-e-uka gannar dakbaloed. Ar yaa bar nasgussulile, degi, aka bur bergumai daklegele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidik guye.’ Ar ade, unnila binsa uka ainisad. Geb degine, dule na e-mor enukoed, geb dule swilidik gunonikoed.
”Uka-oyoapid-sorbali, we-dulega yaa nasgudele, dule-irwa-anse-goledse gannar e-uka oyonabaloed.
Dule-irwa-anse-goled we-dule-e-uka dakoed. Ar yaa-siid nasgumai-dakele, we-dule swilidiksurye sogoed, ar we-yaade, naibe-buna-yaa gued.”
Dule-ukagi yaa-siged e-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Dule ukagi yaa siile, dule-irwa-anse-goledse seledoed.
Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-e-uka dakoed. Ar uka-engunaid, degi, e-sigamar, sipuu naile, deginbali, e-san-gisigwad magar-daklebalile,

wedi, naibe-buna-yaa bur buledid. Dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksuli guye, nue-boni-nikaye.’ Degisoggu, bar bachikii we-dule-mesosulid, ar ade, bato wismalad, we-dule, swilidiksuli gued.
”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-uka bela nonose-bakale, nagadukuse-nasgumai dakele,
geb we-dule-e-uka argaoed. Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled, bela binsa-uka-nika dakele, sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidik guye.’ Ar e-uka bela sipuu naded-ulale, we-dule swilidik gunonikid.
Ar e-ukagi e-san-gisigwad daklealirdi, adi, soglegoed, we-dule, swilidiksurye.
Dule-irwa-anse-goled we-san-gisigwad dakoed, geb sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ Ar san-gisigwad, swilidiksulid. We-boni naibe-buna-yaa gued.
”Ar san-gisi-dakleged sipuu daklenadele, dule-naibe-buna-yaa-nikadi dule-irwa-anse-goledse naoed,
adi, ega yaa-siid dakegar. Ar yaa sipuu daklenadele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidikye.’ Deyobi, dule swilidik gunonikoed.”
Ukagi dusi-siged-igar
Bab Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Ar dule-gwensak e-ukagi dusi siile, degi, sorba nugunonikile,
geb dusi-sigisadgi ega uka-enguardibe, gutu-gisi-sipusaar naguardibe, dule-irwa-anse-goledse oyonaoed,
adi, ega uka dakegar. Ar dusi-sigisadgi ise-nue-gulluu daklegele, degi, e-siga sipuu nadele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule swilidiksurye.’ Ar ade, dusi-sigisadgi naibe-buna-yaa signonikid.
Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled we-dusi-sigisadgi siga sipuu daksulile, degi, ise-nue-gulluu daksulile, aka bur dulega yaa bergumai-dakele, ibagugle (7) dule-baigangi bachikii we-dule-mesoed.
Ar yaa-siid bela uka-ugakaase nasgudele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ Ar ade, naibe-buna-yaa nikad.
Ar yaa-siid bar dungusulile, deginbali, uka-sipu-naid bar nasgusurbalile, aka bur nugumaile, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidikye.’ ”
Dule-gummaksad-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Dule-gwensak gummaksale, geb gummakaledgi uka sipuu naguardibe, igi, gisii naguardibe,

dule-irwa-anse-goled we-gummakaled dakoed. Ar gummakaledgi e-siga sipuu naile, degi, yaa ise-nue-gulluu daklegele, wedi gummakaledgi naibe-buna-yaa signonikid. Dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ Ar ade, we-dule naibe-buna-yaa nikad.

”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled gummakaled-daksadgi, dakalile, siga sipuu gussuli, deginbali, yaa ise-nue-gulluu daklesurbali, aka bur bergumai dakele, dule-irwa-anse-goled ibagugle (7) dule-baigangi bachikii we-dule-mesoed.
Ibagugle-gusale (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled gannar ega uka dakbaloed. Ar yaa-siid bela uka-ugakaase nasgudele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidikidsurye.’ Ar ade, naibe-buna-yaa nikad.
Ar yaa-siid nasgusulirdi, unnila gummaksad-e-gannar gued. Degisoggu, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidikye.’ Ar ade, unnila gummaksad-e-wilub gued.”
Nonogi, degi, akugi-yaa-siged-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Machered-wargwengi, igi, omegindibe, e-nonogi yaa sigialile, igi, e-akugi yaa sigialile,

dule-irwa-anse-goled we-yaa dakoed. Ar we-yaa ise-nue-gulluu daklegele, e-sigamar gordik, degi, ichee daklegele, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ Ar wedi nono-yaa, degi, aku-yaa nikad.
Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled we-yaa-daksadgine, dakele, yaa gulluu daklesuli, deginbali, e-sigamar sichii daklesuli, ibagugle (7) dule-boni-nikad dulemar-baigangi bachikii mesoed.
Ibagugledgine (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled we-dule nue, argaoed. We-yaa-maleged nasgussulile, degine, a-yaagi e-sigamar gordiksulile, degine, yaade dogdar-gulluu daklesulile,
geb agi, e-siga-emiega we-dule-imakoed. Unnila yaa-siidgi e-siga emiosulid. Geb degi, dule-irwa-anse-goled we-dule-yaa-nikad gannar ibagugle (7) dulemar-baigangi bachikii mesoed.

Ibagugledgine (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled gannar nue-argabaloed. We boni-nikad e-ukagi nasgussulile, degine, yaa asginegwale, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidikye, boni nikasurye.’ We-dulede na e-mor enukoed, degi, soglegoed, we swilidikye.
”San uruksad-sorba boni-nikad ega nasgudele,
dule-irwa-anse-goled nue-argaoed. Boni-nikad ukagi nasgudele, dule-irwa-anse-goled siga-gordikid bar amiosulid. We-dule boni-nikad, burbar swilidiksulid.
Ar boni nasgumai daklesulile, degine, siga-sichigana ainialile, we-dule-bonigwaledi nugusad. We-dule, bonigwarsulid. Dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule swilidikye.’ ”
Ukagi yaa-binsaled-siged-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Amba deyobbalodo, machered-gwensak, igi, ome-gwensakdibe, na e-ukagi uka sipuu naguardibe,
dule-irwa-anse-goled ega uka argaoed. Dule-ukagi uka-sipu-naid wis sichisaar daklegele, adi, we binsa uka siid. We-dule, swilidik gued.”
Sailagia-bated-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Ar dule-gwensak-ibe sailagia babatialile, degi, sailagia-sate gunonikile, we-dule, swilidikidye soglegoed.
Ar dule-ibe sailagia-bebegined babatialile, degi, e-bebe swiri gunonikile, we-dule swilidikidye soglegoed.
Ar e-nono-swirigwad-dakasik, igi, e-bebegindibe, yaa gisisaar siile, wedi naibe-buna-yaa siid.
Geb degine, dule-irwa-anse-goled ega yaa dakoed. Ar dakalile, we-yaa-dule-nono-swiregedgi-siid gisisaar daklege, ar igi ukagi naibe-buna-yaa-siir dakledae,
deyob daklegele, we-dule, naibe-buna-yaa nikad. Degisoggu, dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ Ar ade, dule, e-nonogi yaa siid.”
Dule-yaa-maleged-nikad-igar

Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Dule-yaa-maleged-nikadi mor-achirmakaled yooed, gwiosurbalid, degi, e-wagar-negabar-odukuar-nadapi binnasuli gornadapoed: ‘¡An swilidiksuli! ¡An swilidiksuli!’
Dule yaa-maleged-nika-gudiidgine, enik soglegoed: ‘We-dule, swilidiksurye.’ We-dule, swilidiksursoggu, na walagwen mai guoed. Dulemar-danar-danar-bukwad-magaba mai guoed.”
Morgi-gutu-nagued-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Sibad-wawaad-absargi-mor-makaledgine, degi, lino-dubgi-mor-makaledgine, gutu-nai daklealile,
degi, lino-dubgi-mor-sobaledgine, sibad-wawaad-absargi-mor-sobaledgine, ibmar-ukagine, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaledgine, gutu-nai daklealile,
ar we-gutu-naid gwili-absargii-dakledibe, igi, gisisaar-dakledibe, wedi, boni-dummad gued. Degisoggu, dule-irwa-anse-goledse oyogoed.
”Dule-irwa-anse-goled we-gutu-naid dakoed. Geb we-ibmar-gutu-naid ibagugle (7) bachikii urboed.

Dule-irwa-anse-goled ibagugledgi (7) gannar we-gutu-naid argaoed. Ar we-gutu-naid, morgi, mor-sobaledgi, ibmar-ukagi, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaledgi nasgusale, wedi, boni-dummad gued. We-ibmarmar bar nuedsulid.
Degisoggu, mor, mor-sobaled, ibmar-uka, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaled, deyob-gutu-nikamalad, bela ogumaklegoed. Ar ade, boni-dummad gued. Ibmarmar bela ogumaklegoed.
”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled ibmar-nue-arganaidgi, we-gutu-naid, morgi, mor-sobaledgi, ibmar-ukagi, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaledgi nasgussuli dakele,
dule-irwa-anse-goled sogoed: ‘Ibmar-gutu-nikad enukmarye.’ Geb we-ibmarmar gannar ibagugle (7) bachikii urbebaloed.

”Ibmar-gutu-nikad enuklesad-sorba, dule-irwa-anse-goled gannar ibmar-dakbaloed. Ar dakele, gutu-naid bergussuli, amba gannar nai, gutu nasgussur-inigwele, soglegoed: ‘We, ibmar-nuedsurye, bela ichakwaye.’ Degisoggu, we-ibmar ogumaklegoed.
”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled ibmar-enuklesad-sorba we-gutu-naid boree-nai dakalile, morgi-gutu-naid, ibmar-ukagi-gutu-naid, degi, mor-sobaledgi-gutu-naid sikoed.
Ar we-gutu-naid gannar morgi-nai, mor-sobaledgi-nai, ibmar-ukagi-nai, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaledgi-nai daklealile, wedi, gannar boni-dummad nagualid. Ar gutu-naid ogumaklegoed.
”Ar mor, mor-sobaled, ibmar-uka, degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaled enuklesadgine gutu-naid allisale, we-ibmarmar gannar enuklebaloed, geb we-ibmarmar swilidik gunonikoed.

content.text: degi, ibmar-ukagi-ibmar-sobaledgi boni-gutu-naidga, weyobi igar megoed.
Adi, soglegega, we-ibmar swilidikye, igi, swilidiksurye.”
